main.description: Annotation of a sub-string within rich text. Mirrors app.bsky.richtext.facet.

mention.description: A mention of an account. The handle is resolved to a DID when the post is written; the DID is what the facet stores.

link.description: A hyperlink. The AppView only indexes http and https links.

byteSlice.description: A text segment, as UTF-8 byte offsets (not UTF-16 code units, not graphemes). Start is inclusive, end exclusive. Both must fall on character boundaries inside the text; the AppView drops posts whose facets do not.
